title: Tsunami Umino's Kuroema Manga Ends in Next Chapter
content: The July issue of Kodansha 's Kiss magazine revealed on Monday that Tsunami Umino 's Kuroema Chole et Emma manga will end in the magazine's next issue on June 25. The manga's story begins when Emma, a 30-year-old woman, loses her love life, job, and home in one fell swoop, as the boyfriend she was living with breaks…

title: A Classic ’90s MTV Animated Series Is Finally Coming to Netflix (Release Date Confirmed)
content: One of MTV’s most legendary animated shows from the 1990s is about to make a major comeback with a new streaming release with Netflix coming this Summer. Netflix is getting ready for the Summer with the first reveal of many of the new licensed shows and exclusives coming to the streaming service beginning this June .
author: ComicBook

title: 2025 Produced a Truly Exceptional Anime, Yet the Crunchyroll Anime Awards Ignored It
content: The Crunchyroll Anime Awards 2026 have come to an end, and while this year saw some anime receive deserving wins, there were disappointments as well. Solo Leveling once again came out on top in two categories it arguably did not deserve.
author: ComicBook

title: Sal Jiang's Wicked Spot Manga Ends in 2 Chapters
content: Sal Jiang announced on X (formerly Twitter ) on Sunday the Wicked Spot manga will end in chapter 16. Kadokawa published the 14th chapter on May 22, and will publish the 15th chapter on June 26.
author: ANN

title: Kan Takahama Launches New Manga
content: The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for LEED Publishing 's Torch web platform announced on Friday Kan Takahama is launching a new manga in collaboration with Nagasaki's Huis Ten Bosch theme park titled Anchoring Dutchman . The first chapter is available to read now.
author: ANN

title: The Ryuo's Work Is Never Done Light Novels' 21st, Final Volume Listed With July 15 Release
content: SB Creative is lsiting the 21st and final volume of Shirow Shiratori 's The Ryuo's Work Is Never Done! light novel series with a July 15 release date. SB Creative 's GA Bunko light novel label revealed on January 4 earlier this year that the 21st volume will be the final volume.
author: ANN

title: U-NEXT Holdings to Acquire GoHands Anime Studio as 100%-Owned Subsidiary
content: Through this acquisition, U-NEXT Holdings aims to integrate U-NEXT (formerly GyaO! NEXT, self-described as Japan's biggest streaming platform) with the high-quality animation production capacity of GoHands .

title: One Piece Reveals Fan-Favorite Straw Hat’s Surprise Origin After 19 Years

title: Webtoon-Based Live-Action Movie Purge List Confirms Production, Lead Cast
content: Korean news outlet JTBC reported on Friday that a live-action film adaptation of the webtoon Purge List ( Salsaengbu ) is in development. The outlet also confirmed the lead cast featuring Woo-sung Jung , Sung-il Jung, and Ha-joon Wi.
